an10.35:1.1: “Bhante, how many qualities should a bhikkhu possess to give dependence?”
an10.35:1.2: “A bhikkhu who possesses ten qualities, Upāli, may give dependence.
an10.35:1.4: The same ten qualities as in the preceding sutta.
an10.35:1.14: “A bhikkhu who possesses these ten qualities may give dependence.”
